verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS that could plausibly ship a natural-language assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only a GraphQL API with OAuth service accounts, UI features such as report building and bulk granting, and probes showing no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. Nothing shows the product accepting natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
